intelligence.enrichment: Proteins are important food components; the right amount of protein is needed in growing children for proper growth and development, and sportspersons need larger quantities to build muscles. adequate protein in the diet -> growth, development, and muscle building support The learner correctly applies this rule: Proteins are important food components; the right amount of protein is needed in growing children for proper growth and development, and sportspersons need larger quantities to build muscles. Protein-rich foods are just another form of instant energy food, so they are interchangeable with glucose.
